name: H.B. Fuller Company
tagline: A leading worldwide formulator, manufacturer and marketer of adhesives, sealants and other specialty chemical products
hero_kpi_rationale: Le projet stratégique ONE représente un investissement majeur en IT pour transformer l'efficacité opérationnelle, avec un impact structurel sur les coûts futurs et la scalabilité. Montant cumulé de 265 millions USD sur 13 ans de mise en œuvre, reflétant l'ampleur de cette transformation transversale.

ai_positioning.summary: FUL does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning or related topics in its 2025 10-K filing. No AI strategies, initiatives or risks are disclosed.

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to economic risks including recessions, which may negatively impact sales and profitability. Discretionary consumer spending is subject to reduction due to economic uncertainties. (Item 1A, p. 27) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is vulnerable to global economic fluctuations and recession impacts

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to interest rate changes from floating rate credit facilities used to fund operations, affecting borrowing costs and profitability. (Item 7A, p. 27) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is sensitive to interest rate variations on floating debt

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to foreign exchange risks across 34 countries of operations, which may impact sales and profitability. (Item 1A, p. 27) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is vulnerable to currency exchange rate fluctuations

risks.title: Raw Materials Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to raw materials price volatility, which may impact costs and profitability. (Item 1A, p. 28) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is sensitive to raw materials and commodity price variations

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company holds significant goodwill that may be impaired by economic fluctuations and business environment changes. Fair values of reporting units exceeded carrying values by 33-80% in 2025 impairment test. (Item 8, p. 16) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is vulnerable to goodwill impairment from adverse economic conditions

risks.title: Internal Controls Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company maintains internal controls but remains exposed to potential control failures or ineffectiveness. (Item 8, p. 16) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is sensitive to internal control failures

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to reputation risks as a global manufacturer and marketer in specialty chemicals, which could impact sales and brand value. (Item 1A, p. 26) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is exposed to reputational damage from product quality or safety issues

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
